epic: Epic: User Authentication. As a platform admin, I want secure auth so that only authorized users access the system. ACs: register, login+JWT, token expiry 24h, rate limit 5/15min, password complexity.
experiments: E-012 APPROVED (bcrypt cost=12, login p95=45ms). All ACs map to measured experiments except rate limiting which is [HYPOTHESIS].
architecture: Stack: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis. src/auth/ with bcrypt, JWT RS256. Rate limiter middleware (sliding window).

epic: Epic: Payment Processing. As a customer, I want to pay via card/PayPal so that I complete my purchase. ACs: card validation, Stripe, idempotency, retry 3x, 3D Secure (hypothesis).
experiments: E-021 PENDING (3D Secure not approved). AC5 (3D Secure) must be [HYPOTHESIS] until approved. Other ACs map to E-019 APPROVED.
architecture: Payment module: src/payment/ with Stripe SDK, PayPal REST. Webhook handler. Redis idempotency keys.

epic: Epic: Search Autocomplete. As a user, I want suggestions as I type so that I find products faster. ACs: 2-char trigger, 10 suggestions, rank by popularity, recent searches, keyboard nav, debounce 300ms.
experiments: E-015 APPROVED (index latency 2ms p95). All ACs agent-verifiable with measured experiments.
architecture: React frontend with debounced input. FastAPI endpoint. Elasticsearch completion suggester. Redis cache top 1000 queries.
